dataset.generatedBy: Claude (architecture and security lead), task M9.0-A, research and data preparation only
dataset.hierarchy: UGC NET > Paper > Subject > Unit > Topic > Subtopic (official text lives in unit.officialText; topics and subtopics are an editorial layer that must cite it through officialRefs)
dataset.purpose: Machine-readable curriculum skeleton for UrEducator 2.0 with source provenance and verification status at every level.

importPolicy.reason: No syllabus text has been read from an official source and nothing is above verification level V1.
allowedUses: Seed the subject catalogue as DRAFT rows (code, name, layout) after owner approval
Drive the M9.0 capture checklist (documents[] lists every file to capture)
Test the validator and the importer in the emulator
forbiddenUses: Marking any subject or unit as verified or fully_verified
Showing unit or topic names to students as official syllabus

dataset.notAnOfficialPublication: UrEducator is not an official NTA or UGC product. Names and links are cited as sources only.
dataset.noInventedContent: No unit, topic, statement or translation was written from memory or taken from a coaching site. Every empty content field is a recorded gap.

verificationLevels.V0: Not reached. Nothing claimed about the content.
verificationLevels.V1: Observed through a page-reading tool that summarises documents on 5 Nov 2026. Not checked by a person against the PDF.
verificationLevels.V2: Human-verified against a downloaded PDF whose SHA-256 is recorded.
verificationLevels.V3: Dual-verified: two different people completed V2 independently.

translationPolicy: Every localized text carries a provenance: OFFICIAL_VERBATIM (needs a source document and a page, and level V2 or above), TRANSLATION_UNVERIFIED or TRANSLATION_REVIEWED (need translatedFrom, translatedBy and the source document). A machine rendering is never official.

syllabusVersions.label: Updated Syllabi of UGC-NET (Applicable from June 2019 UGC-NET Onwards)
syllabusVersions.note: One catalogue-wide banner. The page gives no per-subject date, version or history. A banner year does not prove that nothing changed since 2019, and does not prove that every listed subject existed in 2019 (subjects 102-105 may be later additions; their first appearance was not established).

syllabusVersions.label: Syllabus of a subject first seen in the NTA list dated 30.04.2026 (codes 106 Forestry, 107 Statistics)
syllabusVersions.note: S13 (bulletin, 85 subjects, codes 01-105) lacks these two; S14 (30.04.2026, 87 subjects) has them. The catalogue banner (S4) appears on the page that lists them but cannot mean these syllabi applied from June 2019. The Forestry file is named 'Final Edited ...'. Effective date not established.

mechanicalCheck.note: Counts reconcile: 87 - 2 = 85. The two extra subjects (Forestry 106, Statistics 107) entered between the June 2026 bulletin and the NTA list of 30.04.2026. This is V1 and an inference from counts, not from a notice that says 'subjects added'. It also explains the Careers360 '85 to 86' lead (register D9) as incomplete.

amendmentCheck.question: Was the UGC NET syllabus (Paper I or any Paper II subject) officially revised after the June 2019 catalogue banner?
amendmentCheck.method: Read the official pages and notices reachable from this environment; look for any notice, bulletin statement, FAQ or archive title announcing a revised, new or updated syllabus. Coaching and news sites were not used as authorities.

checkedSources.finding: No statement of syllabus revision or effective date (section 3.3).
Section 2.3 only points to the UGC website; no revision statement. Appendix-II has 85 subjects.
Subject list of 30.04.2026 adds Forestry (106) and Statistics (107) relative to S13. A subject-list change, not a statement about syllabus text.
Section 4.3 only points to the UGC website; no revision statement.
Q35 points to the catalogue; no revision statement.
Page 1 of 2: no title mentions syllabus, scheme, amendment or revised.
Archive titles April 2022 - September 2026: no syllabus revision notice; only the June 2026 subject list.
UGC page holds no syllabus text; points to ugcnetonline.in.
Home page (re-read 5 Nov 2026): no syllabus link; no notice title mentions the syllabus.
Bulletin listing: titles only (Updated Bulletin as on 16.10.2026, 08.10.2026, June 2026, earlier); no syllabus notice.
Banner 'Applicable from June 2019 UGC-NET Onwards'; no per-row dates.

notReadable.why: Corrigendum of 16 Oct 2026 blocked; contents unknown.
No syllabus PDF could be read, so no PDF front-matter dates (issue date, revision date) are known.

amendmentCheck.conclusion: No official notice announcing a revised syllabus was found in the pages that could be read. This is absence of evidence only, not proof that no revision exists: the corrigendum (S6) and every syllabus PDF are unread, and no per-document date could be seen.
doNotAssume: that the June 2019 syllabus is unchanged
that the June 2019 syllabus has been replaced
nonAuthoritativeLeadsNotUsed: Coaching and news pages claiming 'new syllabus' or 'latest changes', and a Careers360 article of 29 Apr 2026 (register S9/D9). Not cited as sources.

gaps.title: Paper I syllabus text not read
gaps.detail: The 10 units, every topic and statement, in English and Hindi, were not read from any official document. The catalogue link (S4) redirects to an expiring pre-signed storage URL and the reading tool rejected it as too long. The unit count of 10 comes from the owner's brief, not from a source.
gaps.resolution: M9.0 capture of Paper-I_English.pdf and Paper-I_Hindi.pdf on a normal machine with SHA-256, then two-person transcription (V3). See handoff in the validation report.

gaps.title: Paper II syllabus text not read for any subject
gaps.detail: 86 of 87 Paper II subjects were never opened. Subject 107 was partly observed (ten unit titles, tool-rendered, document identity doubtful, see GAP-11). No topic or statement text exists for any subject.
gaps.resolution: Capture and transcribe subject by subject as each is scheduled (M9.5 in the roadmap).

gaps.title: Corrigendum to the December 2026 bulletin unread
gaps.detail: S6 is blocked. It might change the subject list, the exam pattern or syllabus pointers.
gaps.resolution: Owner or Antigravity captures S6 and S3 with hashes (register owner action O-3).

gaps.title: Per-document dates and titles unknown
gaps.detail: No syllabus PDF was opened, so document title, issue date, revision date, page count and page numbers are all unknown. Document titles are null except one search-result title for Paper-I English, which is a lead only.
gaps.resolution: Read the first page and metadata of each captured PDF.

gaps.title: Applicable exam period is a catalogue banner, not a per-subject fact
gaps.detail: Only the page-wide banner 'June 2019 onwards' exists. Subjects 106 and 107 cannot have applied from June 2019; 102-105 are unestablished.
gaps.resolution: Per-subject effective dates from UGC notices or document front-matter.

gaps.title: No SHA-256 for any source
gaps.detail: No file was downloaded, so no hash, size or page count exists. Provenance for a syllabus cannot rest on a URL because the links redirect to expiring URLs.

gaps.title: Hindi text fidelity
gaps.detail: The one Hindi document seen came back with corrupted Devanagari (legacy-font PDF). Hindi syllabus text must be typed or visually checked, never taken from a text layer. No Hindi title or statement is stored in this dataset.

gaps.title: Language-subject flag is the author's inference
gaps.detail: 29 rows are marked as language subjects from their names only. The bulletin has no per-subject medium table.
gaps.resolution: Owner or UGC clarification of paper medium per subject.

gaps.title: subjects.php unread; the three subject lists are V1 only
gaps.detail: The three subject lists agree on the code set (S3, S4, S14) but all three were read through a summarising tool.
gaps.resolution: A person compares codes and names against the PDF text.

gaps.title: Code printing differs between sources
gaps.detail: S14 prints three digits (001), S3 and S4 print two where the number is below 100 (01), and S3 footnotes print 015 and 074. Codes are stored as strings with the NTA three-digit form as canonical.
gaps.resolution: Normalise on import; keep printed variants.

gaps.title: Identity of the document behind the Statistics observation
gaps.detail: The ten Statistics unit titles came from a document the tool returned for a different showPdf link (register D8). The text identified it as the Statistics Hindi syllabus but the file's identity is unproven. The English titles are the tool's own rendering of Hindi.
gaps.resolution: Re-read from the captured Statistics English and Hindi PDFs.

gaps.title: Two later-added subjects and a 'June 2019' banner
gaps.detail: See GAP-05. 106 and 107 are assigned to version sv-undated-added-2026.
gaps.resolution: Find the notice that added them.
